promptTranslations.en: Create an animation based on code to quickly review 5,000 years of Chinese history. Keep the style lighthearted and fun, use line art format, include suitable music, and ensure it is engaging.

summary: Author used Gemini 4 Argon to generate a multi-part web code animation summarizing 5,000 years of Chinese history in a sketch style.
summaryEn: Chinese History Line Art Animation via Code

post.originalText:
震撼了，Gemini 4 Argon 做的中华五千年的历史。。。提示词很简单：基于代码做一个动画，快速回顾中华五千年的历史。风格轻松有趣，动画格式为线稿，添加合适的音乐，请务必做到引人入胜

完整版足足有12个短动画，这一切都是 Gemini 4 Argon 基于一句提示词一次对话自动完成，总耗时不超过5分钟。

完整版在：https://t.co/BDC1HLmrwN
